| description = 
* In [[Southern Karana]], these are found at the undead camp with [[Ghanex Drah]] (1500, 1200) near the [[North Karana]] zone line.
* In [[Qeynos Hills]], there are two putrid skeletons that spawn every 6:40, with no placeholders — one at 3341, 543 and the other at 2088,-848. These two kinds of putrid skeletons appear to be different: the Qeynos Hills ones drop a [[Putrid Rib Bone]], while the South Karana ones do not. The Qeynos Hills ones proc [[Putrid Breath]], which is similar or identical to [[Rabies]] but does not last nearly as long.  The putrid skeletons in Qeynos Hills also do not give faction (confirmed on Green, May 21, 2020).
* There are also putrid skeletons on the first floor of [[Befallen]].
* Those found in [[Southern Karana]] have interesting dying words: "Come and join Barger.", "Bertoxxuloussss... shall find you.", "[[Cromil's Remains|Cromil]] shall cut you in two.", "Come... Come and join Tolon!", "Feel the power of Gandil the Great!", "Never fear... Smyth isss... Here!", "Westyn shall gut you." "Come, let Bozin embrace you."
